newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta seen higher on Q1 results, Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta seen higher on Q1 results, Wall Street.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are expected to be higher in early trade on Friday with first quarter results of some major companies likely to boost sentiment, brokers said.
They said the rise in the Dow Jones on Thursday as Wall Street welcomed plans to lower the capital gains tax rate could also provide further stimulus to the market.
"Announcement of first quarter results by some companies are sound and better than our expectations. They will attract buyers' attention," one local broker said.
